scenario_description:
Objective: Complete LP-8's already-started outbound transfer from the museum dock within its reserved lender receiving window.
Emerging Need: After the packed crate leaves holding, the primary truck's liftgate locks out and the loading crew halts with no usable vehicle.
Decision Context: The receiving dock closes at noon; a brief compatible standby slot appears, while a registrar record contains the only preapproved substitution, booking authority, and dispatch details.
Consequence: The authorized contingency can resume the same transfer and preserve handoff, but once standby is allocated elsewhere, neither the disabled primary truck nor remaining arrivals can reach the lender that day.

parameter.title: LP-8 outbound transfer and lender receiving
parameter.description: Dock 2 loading begins at 08:30. LP-8 receiving at Seaward Heritage Center is reserved from 11:30 to 12:00, when its loading dock closes. A conditioned art truck with a rated liftgate is required.
parameter.location: Harbor County Museum Dock 2 to Seaward Heritage Center

parameter.content: We began the LP-8 outbound move at 08:31. The packed crate is out of the holding bay, secured on the museum gantry trolley, and beside the Coastline truck for liftgate alignment.

parameter.subject: Vehicle incident during LP-8 loading
parameter.body: The assigned truck's hydraulic liftgate entered a mechanical lockout during alignment at Dock 2. Loading has stopped, and the vehicle cannot accept the LP-8 crate. Our field mechanic cannot arrive before 12:30, and Coastline has no spare vehicle available today.

parameter.subject: Harbor County standby board: GP-4 available
parameter.body: GP-4, equipped with a rated liftgate and conditioned cargo bay, is unassigned from 09:15 to 12:30. Dispatch estimates arrival at Harbor County Museum by 09:20 and at Seaward Heritage Center by 11:40. The slot remains on the open board until 09:05 and is allocated on first confirmation.

parameter.subject: GP-4 standby allocation closed
parameter.body: The GP-4 standby listing closed at 09:05 and the vehicle has been allocated to another movement. The earliest remaining Gull Point vehicle can reach Harbor County Museum at 12:20.
